_doc: E-A MUTATION-COVERAGE MANIFEST (A+ tranche 2, bar 1 CORRECTNESS).
Every correctness-asserting invariant test file (enumeration rule:
tests/lint/mutationCoverage.shared.mjs) must appear here with one of:
kind:'mutation'  — a planted regression in scripts/mutation-sweep.sh proves the
invariant reds (label = the check_caught* label there);
kind:'rationale' — a documented reason mutation-testing is redundant or
kind:'uncovered' — a known gap, counted against uncoveredBaseline (shrink-only,
exact-equality: drive toward 0 by upgrading entries).
The 'meta' section carries non-test-file invariants (eslint config bans) the
new invariant with no entry REDS; stale entry REDS; label claims match the
sweep script bidirectionally; uncovered count matches the baseline exactly.

rationales.pglite-executed: Executed-SQL boundary test: it loads the real migration SQL into pglite and asserts behavior by EXECUTION — the stronger form of proof this sweep approximates for source-scan invariants. Its mutation target is committed migration SQL; transiently mutating shared migration files risks discarding parallel-session work, and each pglite boot is heavy, so standing family-level mutation proof lives in the sweep areas security/runIf migration renumber, security/verify_jwt platform gate loosened, and security/public table without RLS. Per-suite mutation proofs were executed at build time (each suite’s Done-when in docs/A_PLUS_ROADMAP.md).
rationales.postgres-concurrency-executed: Executed two-backend PostgreSQL concurrency contract: CI provisions a real PostgreSQL service and the test coordinates independent client sessions to observe the owner-lock wait before exercising the shared command row. That live wait-for graph and the explicit 40P01 failure assertion are stronger than a source-scan mutation. Transiently rewriting shared migration SQL inside the mutation sweep would risk parallel work and still could not reproduce the required concurrent backend schedule more faithfully.
rationales.golden-byte-pin: Same-seed golden byte/structure pin over the full seeded pipeline. Its catching power is exercised operationally: legitimate behavior shifts redden the affected goldens and are recorded in the golden-shift ledgers (docs/GOLDEN_SHIFT_LEDGER*.md). A synthetic planted mutation would need a hand-crafted behavior-changing kernel edit per golden plus two full pipeline runs each in the sweep — redundant proof at disproportionate cost.
rationales.self-proving-meta: Guard-the-guard meta-test that injects its own broken fixtures (a fake failing tsc, a temp baseline) and asserts the enforcer reds — the mutation proof is embedded in the test body and executes on every suite run.
rationales.walker-totality-executed: Source-scan totality walker (E-D family) for the admin-actions two-key rule: its catching power is the exact-partition classification (every switch case in exactly one of PROTECTED / MODERATION / UNGATED) plus the client routing scan. BOTH mutation plants were executed at build time and proven red-then-green (drop a protected action from the manifest -> the unclassified-case assertion reds; route a protected action via a bare onClick runAction -> the client-scan reds). A standing sweep plant would duplicate that build-time proof at the cost of transiently mutating the shared edge-fn source each sweep.
rationales.hook-theme-totality-executed: Data-table totality walker (HK-1) holding src/generators/hookThemes.js in exact set equality with the authored pools it tags. All THREE rot modes were planted and proven red-then-green at build time (2026-08-03): drop a theme row -> the both-directions totality test reds naming the untagged template; retag a row to a theme outside HOOK_THEMES -> the closure test reds; edit a tagged template's prose without moving its tag -> totality reds in both directions at once. Restoring the file returned 7/7 green (attribution control). A standing sweep plant would re-execute that same set comparison while transiently mutating an authored data table — the class of file the sweep's dirty-tree guard exists to keep out of harm's way — for no additional catching power.
rationales.edge-lifecycle-double-pin: Cross-file edge lifecycle contract test whose source-level assertions are paired with execution of the same production paths in the full Deno edge suite. A transient sweep mutation would duplicate both layers while editing shared payment or deletion source during the sweep.
rationales.discourse-parity-variant: Cross-surface lit-decade variant (tranche 3c) driving the discourse realizer over a real recorded DAG to prove its connected prose introduces zero unrecorded claims and zero contradictions vs the chronicle. The realizer's PRODUCT correctness is mutation-covered by tests/lint/discourseLexiconCoverage.test.js (the planted 'discourse/lexicon relation-type coverage gap' regression) plus the clause-provenance composition pin in tests/domain/discourseKernel.test.js; a second planted mutation here would duplicate that at the cost of a full sim drive per sweep. Its distinct value is the real-drive claims/direction/spell-break census, which a synthetic source mutation cannot target beyond the coverage the totality walker already proves.
rationales.live-constant-coupling: Executed coupling pin: the test imports BOTH sides of the contract live — the cap constant (e.g. MAX_EVENT_NARRATIVE_SNAPSHOTS) and the copy table — and asserts the user-facing disclosure string contains the constant's current value. Each mutation direction (changing the constant without the copy, or dropping/weakening the disclosure sentence) reds the assertion by construction on every ordinary suite run; a planted sed of either side would re-execute that identical check at sweep cost, adding no catching power.
rationales.arcane-census-executed-2026-08-03: Executed discovery proof at authoring time (MG-3h, chair ruling R-BLD-5). The census's catching power was demonstrated BEFORE any baseline existed: run against unmutated src/ it surfaced EIGHT previously unrecorded arcane/ambiguous classifiers in seven files (districtProfile, npcProfile x2, stressorDynamics, tierOutcomeApply, factionRoles, isolationGenerator, contradictions) that the leak register had never seen — a walker that finds real unknown members of its class on first run is not vacuous. It also self-proves on every run: the KNOWN_UNCONVERTED shrink-only check reds if any recorded site stops matching, and the not-vacuous check reds if the glob stops finding source. The mutation target is the WHOLE shared src/ tree, which carries three other lanes' dirty and untracked files, so a standing perl plant is exactly the case the sweep's dirty-tree guard exists to refuse. Promote to kind:mutation once src/ is quiescent. ⭐ SECOND EXECUTED PROOF, 2026-08-03 (the per-alternation allowlist): a mixed alternation `/mage|tower|academy/i` was planted inside an ALLOWLISTED file (src/domain/magicLedger.js, verified tracked-and-clean first, reverted by pathspec checkout in the same shell) and the census was run twice — the HEAD version with its file-scoped skip passed 5/5 blind, the rebuilt version reported the site by path, line, token split and literal. That A/B is the receipt that the file-scoped exemption was a real hole and that it is now closed. Two further controls executed the same way: a `covers` signature altered by one character reds BOTH the census arm and the stale-exemption arm, and a `why` shortened below the reason floor reds the liveness arm. Still kind:rationale rather than kind:mutation because a STANDING sweep plant would have to live in the shared src/ tree, which remains dirty across three lanes; the controls above were transient and self-reverting, which the sweep's dirty-tree guard cannot be.
rationales.negative-control-executed-2026-07-30: Executed negative-control proof at authoring time (2026-07-30 verified-fix wave): each of these pins was proven non-vacuous by REVERTING the fix it guards (the exact mutation the sweep would plant), observing the suite red on the reverted defect, restoring, and re-running green — receipts quoted in the wave record. The mutation targets sit in files the sweep's dirty-tree guard protects (store slice helpers, edge-function sources), so a standing perl plant adds churn risk without adding proof strength beyond the executed control. Promote to kind:mutation if a standing sweep area later covers these targets.
